c74object.name: videoSync.context
c74object.digest: Video rendering context. Wrapper around jit.world for easier and extended functionalities.
c74object.description: It allows out-of-the-box advanced video output, including compositing and exact-pixel mapping. videoSync.context works seemlessly with the SyncSuite package and Max4Live devices.
